fields.heading: A country that works best state by state.
fields.body: Germany is easiest to misunderstand when treated as one uniform destination. Bavaria does not read like Berlin; Saxony does not read like Hamburg; the Rhine wine villages do not explain the Baltic coast. Atlas starts with the federal states because they are the first useful editorial layer.
